create_sandbox_mturk_requester: create a SandboxMTurkRequester instance by calling SandboxMTurkRequester.new with a MephistoDB and requester name
get_sandbox_client: get a sandbox MTurk client for a given requester name using the _get_client method
check_is_sandbox: check if a requester is on sandbox by calling the is_sandbox class method which returns True
register_sandbox_requester: register a new sandbox requester in the database using SandboxMTurkRequester.new which appends _sandbox to the name
review_sandbox_requester_init: review the SandboxMTurkRequester __init__ to understand how it strips the _sandbox suffix from the requester name
